title: Shift-counter vector coordinate
statement: For every exponential breadth-first search state $st$, the coordinate at index $13$ of its counter vector is the shift counter $C$.
hypotheses_covered: $st$ is an exponential breadth-first search state
replaced:
For a state with the 17 counters $N,Lg,s,s1,X,w,K,Bs,U,V,T,T2,Z,C,ch,c,c1$, the
fourteenth coordinate of its state vector (numbering coordinates from $0$) is the shift
counter $C$.
